harness: H1 custom crimped JST-SH8 to JST-PH8 display harness
board_connection: J6 JST SM08B-SRSS-TB(LF)(SN) / C160407; mate SHR-08V-S-B with eight SSH-003T-P0.2-H contacts
display_connection: Waveshare PH2.0 8-pin; mate PHR-8 with eight SPH-004T-P0.5S contacts
manufacturer_bend_radius: Not supplied for this installed harness. Static dressed bends are engineering approximations requiring prototype trial-fit.
assembly: Order one finished eight-conductor crimped harness. Pin1 to pin1 through pin8 to pin8 by connector circuit numbers, not by apparent face orientation. Wire free length 44+/-1mm between rear housing exits; cable maker adds termination allowances. No inline splices. The supplied kit lead is unused. Continuity and isolation check before power.

mating.insertion_axis: -X toward socket, parallel to display PCB
mating.seating_status: Side-entry inferred from supplied photo and official stepped 20x6x5.6mm socket envelope. Seated reach/axis estimated using JST PH side-entry 9.6mm mated depth; exact Waveshare connector manufacturer, contacts and mating cavity are not supplied. Check actual kit fit before final trimming.

board_mating.dimensions_status: Housing overall dimensions from JST SH drawing; engagement datum and stepped nose are engineering approximations checked against unscaled supplier header STEP. Confirm actual mating fit.

scope: Real mating MPNs, pitch and overall housing dimensions specified from JST drawings. Header uses original unscaled supplier STEP. Cable-housing stepped noses, contacts, seating datums, wire dressing and bends are nominal; actual fit and qualified crimps remain prototype checks.
